== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Arelius family, also known as [[House]] Arelius or the Arelius clan, is a prominent and ancient lineage characterized by its immense wealth, vast resources, and legendary bloodline abilities. Historically, the family held significant power across multiple continents, once ruling much of the [[Rosegold continent]] under the leadership of the [[Tiberian Arelius|Monarch Tiberian Arelius]]. Following his death, the family faced periods of instability and loss, yet they maintained a global presence through various branches. They are recognized for their unique bloodline gift, which provides members with extraordinary sensory perception and awareness, allowing them to see and hear things as if through physical senses rather than [[spiritual perception]]. This ability makes them exceptionally difficult to ambush and highly effective at gathering information. The family's influence is deeply tied to their role in maintaining and cleaning the infrastructure of the [[Blackflame Empire]], a position that grants them access to many secrets. While they have faced significant challenges, including attacks from the [[Jai clan]] and the devastation of their ancestral homes, they remain a formidable force. The family is led by various figures, including [[Underlord|Underlords]] such as Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius and Patriarchs like [[Gaien Arelius]]. Their symbol is a crescent moon, often accompanied by lightning or power-related characters, and they are frequently associated with dark blue, black, and white colors. Despite periods of being leaderless or underfunded, the Arelius family continues to be a major player in the [[sacred arts]] world, utilizing their extensive [[technique]] libraries and ancestral treasures to maintain their status.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Known for their honor, the Arelius family is a major servant group that employs hundreds of thousands of people and flies dark blue and white colors on cloudships. While they are subject only to the great clans of the empire, they provide support to [[Eithan]] and maintain the [[Blackflame Trials]] course. The family utilizes bloodline powers, [[madra]], and [[aura]] to detect threats, see through closed eyes, and locate areas requiring maintenance. Although [[Lindon]] has joined the family to serve them, he is not considered a subject of the Arelius. During recent events, the family faced sabotage from the [[Jai clan]] against their street crews and dealt with matters involving their turtle, [[Orthos]].}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Ranked as the premier major family within [[The Empire|the Empire]], the Arelius family is an [[Underlord]] lineage that maintains the [[cloudship]] [[Sky's Mercy]]. While their bloodline possesses a powerful scouting tool through [[spiritual perception]], certain members rely on physical senses instead. The family is guarded by [[Orthos]] and utilizes wax seals marked with ancient characters and a crescent symbol to transmit messages. Despite their status, they have lost territory to [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]], even as [[Jai Daishou]] attempts to steer a Deepwalker Ape toward them after stealing a severed head from one of their servants. As they are sent home, the family is expected to eventually replace the [[Jai clan]] among the great clans.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Arelius family maintains various administrative centers to manage their affairs. Despite their status, the family lacks the wealth required to afford meat comparable in quality to that of the [[Silverfang Carp]]. Their financial standing is further highlighted by the fact that a single [[void key]] possesses a value equivalent to half of their entire family. Within their social dealings, individuals such as [[Longhook]] have addressed members of the lineage directly. Furthermore, the [[Arelius bloodline]] is distinguished by a specific inherent ability.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Without a [[Monarch]] to guide them, [[House]] Arelius was considered easy prey and faced the threat of [[Reigan Shen]] holding their remaining members hostage to force [[Eithan]]'s withdrawal from the competition. Although they were under Reigan Shen{{!}}Reigan's protection, the family was ultimately left leaderless and in ashes, leaving them unable to properly subsidize [[Eithan]]'s [[advancement]]. Despite their struggles, the family maintained specific employment conditions for their workers and sent a gift to [[Yerin]]. Following an order from the [[Blood Sage]] to relocate, the family's presence is identified by the dark blue color at the base of their [[cloudship]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The influence of [[House]] Arelius is felt throughout the journey, appearing on items such as a canister and a silver cube held by [[Lindon]]. Within the group, two members are only associated with the clan in name alone. == Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]] is a member of the Arelius family, whose forces became embroiled in a distant conflict on the [[Rosegold continent]]. During this clash, [[House]] Arelius troops pushed into territory belonging to [[House Shen]] and found themselves engaged in heavy fighting on the battlefield. The clan faced a difficult situation as they were fought by [[Sage of Calling Storms|Calling Storms]] and [[Yushi]], eventually making a home among ruins and half-standing walls. Amidst these struggles, [[Mercy]] fought to save the house.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The noble [[House]] Arelius is a blond and smug clan known for possessing a stockpile of treasures unmatched across all the worlds. Although they managed to hide from the [[Dread War]], [[Reigan Shen]] claims that the house no longer stands unrivaled. Despite their immense wealth, a fall for [[House]] Arelius is predicted to occur two continents away from [[Moongrave]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“The Arelius family is on their way,” Jai Long said.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“But the Arelius family is not entirely without honor.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Gratitude. Your instruction is appreciated, but I have no voice in the Arelius family.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“What can I do to serve the Arelius family?” Lindon asked, rising from his bed.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" />}}
